text:
Riley: hi team! quick onboarding benefits questions - thanks in advance.
Riley: 1) dental plan A vs B 
 what's the usual pick for folks with braces?
Jordan (People Ops): hey Riley - welcome! most folks with ongoing ortho pick Plan B (higher premium) because ortho coverage kicks in after the waiting period. check the benefits summary PDF for coverage %s.
Riley: got it. where's the PDF? only saw the enrollment confirmation email.
Sam (Benefits): linked here: https://benefits.redwood.ai/summary.pdf (work login needed). Plan B covers 50% of ortho after 12 months, up to $2000 lifetime.
Riley: thanks. 2) HSA question - i put in the max for myself but my partner has separate coverage. can i still contribute full HSA?
Jordan (People Ops): HSA eligibility depends on your selected medical plan. If you're on an HSA-qualified high-deductible plan and not claimed as a dependent on someone else's plan for HSA purposes, you can contribute. If partner's plan covers you, that might disqualify you. DM benefits@redwood.ai with partner plan details and we'll confirm.
Riley: will do. 3) cell stipend - when does that kick in? i started on 3/1.
FinanceBot: Stipend: mobile allowance starts in the next payroll cycle after benefits onboarding completes. For start 2026-03-01, expect first stipend on payroll run 2026-03-15. One-time setup may require submitting phone bill to Concur if you asked for retro pay.
Riley: sweet. 4) PTO accrual vs carryover: i heard unused PTO over X gets capped?
Jordan (People Ops): annual rollover cap is 10 days. Anything above that is paid out at year-end per policy, or use it by Dec 15. Floating holidays do not roll over. Policy link in handbook.
Riley: final Q: is there an office-closed holiday this summer or does Redwood switch to floating days?
Sam (Benefits): we keep the standard observed holidays (NY day, Memorial, 4th July, Thanksgiving, Dec holidays). Each employee also gets 1 floating day per year to use. Check HR calendar for exact dates.
Riley: awesome, thanks. one more minor thing - i uploaded my dependent docs but got an upload error. it said "file too large". any workaround?
Sam (Benefits): try compressing the PDF or use the secure upload link: https://secure-upload.redwood.ai/ (works for files up to 25MB). Reply with the filename when done and i'll confirm.
Riley: uploaded as riley_spouse_marriage_2026.pdf to secure link.
Sam (Benefits): confirmed receipt. We'll process within 3 business days and backdate if within 30-day window.
Riley: perfect. thanks everyone! excited to be here :wave:
Jordan (People Ops): welcome again! ping here or DM if anything else blocks you.
FinanceBot: FYI: if you need an advance for relocation or equipment, submit a ticket to finance-ops and tag ADVANCE-URGENT.
